question: In which of the following states is the Shatrunjaya Hills located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

__
 
• **Shatrunjaya Hills is located in Gujarat**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Shatrunjaya(place of victory against inner enemies) hills are located by the city Palitana, in Bhavanagar district, Gujarat India.
 
 
• They are situated on the banks of the river Shetrunji.
 
• It is the most sacred place for Jains.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
